known_gaps.description: No provisioned OpenFEC API key is present, but this is not a discovery blocker: the FEC publishes no-key bulk database dumps covering Schedule B from 1975 forward and narrower no-key operating-expenditure cycle files from 2003 forward.
known_gaps.next_action: Use the hash-pinned FEC bulk route for reproducible intake; retain the API adapter as a paginated convenience route.

known_gaps.description: Sponsored leadership PACs and joint fundraising committees are outside the first authorized-presidential-campaign-committee subset and must not be narrated as searched.
known_gaps.next_action: Define and source-resolve a second symmetric committee class before querying those committees.

known_gaps.description: Electronic campaign-finance, disclosure, spending, registry, and policy coverage attenuates across earlier administrations, so raw footprint counts are not temporally comparable. The initial four-family, 32-cell source matrix now makes that asymmetry explicit.
known_gaps.next_action: Refine each cell with artifact-level searches, preserve null versus unavailable states, and prohibit unadjusted cross-era ranking.

known_gaps.description: One official FEC 2004 bulk transaction source has been hash-pinned and scanned, but zero financial-disclosure documents have yet been normalized into beneficial-interest rows.
known_gaps.next_action: Resolve amendment chains for the 2004 rows while enumerating OGE and NARA locators for every cohort member; preserve unavailable-after-search outcomes without waiting for selection clearance.

known_gaps.description: Cohort members, offices, committees, beneficial interests, businesses, properties, issuers, and counterparties are not yet resolved as separate canonical nodes.
known_gaps.next_action: Implement cohort-wide entity resolution without creating member-specific entity types or thresholds.

known_gaps.description: The live SEC adapter covers Form D searches, not the required issuer submissions and ownership filings.
known_gaps.next_action: Add accession-number-based SEC submissions retrieval without treating issuer events as personal conduct.
